blocks.zh: GDP 稽核查檢表（下半部）：系統、運輸溫控、退貨、投訴、偽藥、銷毀、人員與安全
blocks.en: GDP Audit Checklist (Part 2): Systems, Transport Temperature Control, Returns, Complaints, Counterfeits, Destruction, Personnel and Safety

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解倉儲管理系統 (WMS) 在藥品配銷中的關鍵功能需求
blocks.en: Understand the key functional requirements of a warehouse management system (WMS) in pharmaceutical distribution

blocks.zh: 掌握保溫運輸系統 (ISS) 的驗證與監控要點
blocks.en: Master the key points for validating and monitoring insulated shipping systems (ISS)

blocks.zh: 了解承運商溫控運輸的稽核重點與安全措施
blocks.en: Understand the audit focus and security measures for temperature-controlled carrier transportation

blocks.zh: 認識客戶退貨、投訴處理、偽藥防範的 GDP 要求
blocks.en: Become familiar with GDP requirements for customer returns, complaint handling and counterfeit prevention

blocks.zh: 掌握人員訓練、安全管理在 GDP 合規中的角色
blocks.en: Understand the role of personnel training and safety management in GDP compliance

blocks.zh: J. Systems (系統)
blocks.en: J. Systems

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：倉儲管理系統 (WMS)
blocks.en: Core Concept: Warehouse Management System (WMS)

blocks.zh: Warehouse Management System (倉儲管理系統)：這是整個配銷作業的「數位神經系統」。一個合格的 WMS 必須能做到：
blocks.en: Warehouse Management System (WMS): This is the "digital nervous system" of the whole distribution operation. A qualified WMS must be able to do the following:

blocks.zh: 批號追蹤 (Lot Tracking)：從入庫到出庫，每個批號的位置、數量、狀態都必須清楚
blocks.en: Lot Tracking: From receipt to dispatch, the location, quantity and status of every lot must be clear

blocks.zh: FEFO 管理：First Expiry, First Out（先到期先出）邏輯，避免產品過期浪費
blocks.en: FEFO Management: First Expiry, First Out logic, to avoid product loss through expiry

blocks.zh: QA Hold 管控：品質保留狀態下，系統必須自動阻止揀貨與出貨
blocks.en: QA Hold Control: While a product is on quality hold, the system must automatically block picking and shipping

blocks.zh: 溫控區域辨識：系統必須自動將冷鏈產品導向冷藏區存放
blocks.en: Temperature-Zone Recognition: The system must automatically direct cold chain products to cold storage

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像 WMS 就像一座大型圖書館的管理系統。每本書（每批藥品）都有唯一編號，系統知道它在哪個書架（儲位）、何時入館（入庫日期）、何時到期（效期）。如果有讀者要借閱（客戶下單），系統會自動找出最該先借出的那本（FEFO 邏輯）。如果某本書被標記為「維修中」（QA Hold），任何人都無法借走它。
blocks.en: Think of a WMS as the management system of a large library. Every book (every lot of product) has a unique number, and the system knows which shelf it is on (storage location), when it came in (receipt date) and when it expires (expiry date). When a reader wants to borrow a book (a customer places an order), the system automatically finds the copy that should go out first (FEFO logic). If a book is marked "under repair" (QA Hold), nobody can borrow it.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：安全與合規
blocks.en: Key Point: Security and Compliance

blocks.zh: 第 21-23 題特別關注安全面向：
blocks.en: Questions 21-23 focus on security:

blocks.zh: 竊盜與轉移 (Theft & Diversion)：藥品是高價值商品，必須有防盜機制與事件追蹤
blocks.en: Theft & Diversion: Medicines are high-value goods, so anti-theft controls and incident tracking are required

blocks.zh: 管制藥品監控：依美國 DEA 規定，異常訂單模式（如數量異常大）必須主動偵測回報
blocks.en: Controlled Substance Monitoring: Under US DEA rules, unusual order patterns (for example, abnormally large quantities) must be proactively detected and reported

blocks.zh: 災難復原 (Disaster Recovery)：系統當機時如何確保資料不遺失、作業不中斷
blocks.en: Disaster Recovery: How data is protected from loss and operations kept running when the system goes down

blocks.zh: 這些項目若不合規，可能導致法律責任甚至刑事處分。
blocks.en: Non-compliance in these areas can lead to legal liability and even criminal penalties.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Questions for Reflection

blocks.zh: 如果 WMS 無法支援 FEFO 邏輯，可能造成什麼後果？
blocks.en: What consequences could follow if the WMS cannot support FEFO logic?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「一個儲位只放一個批號」對 GDP 很重要？
blocks.en: Why is "one lot per storage location" important for GDP?

blocks.zh: RF 掃描技術如何降低人為揀貨錯誤？
blocks.en: How does RF scanning technology reduce human picking errors?

blocks.zh: K. Insulated Shipping Systems (ISS) Transportation Temperature Controls (保溫運輸系統溫控)
blocks.en: K. Insulated Shipping Systems (ISS) Transportation Temperature Controls

blocks.zh: 核心概念：被動式與主動式溫控運輸
blocks.en: Core Concept: Passive and Active Temperature-Controlled Transport

blocks.zh: Insulated Shipping System, ISS（保溫運輸系統）：藥品在運輸途中維持溫度的關鍵裝備。分為兩大類：
blocks.en: Insulated Shipping System (ISS): The key equipment that keeps medicines within temperature during transit. There are two main types:

blocks.zh: 被動式 (Passive)：利用保溫材料+冷媒（如乾冰、相變材料 PCM）維持溫度，無需電力。適合短中程運輸
blocks.en: Passive: Uses insulating material plus refrigerant (such as dry ice or phase change material, PCM) to hold temperature, with no power needed. Suitable for short to medium distances

blocks.zh: 主動式 (Active)：如冷藏車、冷藏貨櫃，有動力製冷設備。適合長程或大量運輸
blocks.en: Active: Such as refrigerated trucks and reefer containers, with powered refrigeration equipment. Suitable for long distances or large volumes

blocks.zh: 本節查檢表聚焦於被動式系統的驗證與管理，因其在「最後一哩」配送中最為普遍。
blocks.en: This section of the checklist focuses on the validation and management of passive systems, as they are the most common in "last mile" delivery.

blocks.zh: 保溫箱就像露營用的冰桶。你必須知道：放多少冰塊（冷媒用量）、冰塊要先冷凍多久才夠冷（conditioning time）、在夏天 vs 冬天能撐多久（季節極端測試）、走高速公路 vs 山路的差別（不同運輸模式）。如果冰塊不夠或品質不對，食物（藥品）就會壞掉。
blocks.en: An insulated shipper is like a camping cooler. You need to know how much ice to put in (coolant quantity), how long the ice must be frozen to be cold enough (conditioning time), how long it lasts in summer versus winter (seasonal extreme testing), and the difference between highway and mountain roads (different transport modes). If the ice is insufficient or of the wrong quality, the food (the medicine) spoils.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：驗證的全面性
blocks.en: Key Point: Comprehensive Validation

blocks.zh: 第 1-6 題要求 ISS 的驗證必須涵蓋：
blocks.en: Questions 1-6 require that ISS validation cover:

blocks.zh: 季節性挑戰：夏季高溫可能超出保溫上限，冬季嚴寒可能導致產品凍結
blocks.en: Seasonal challenges: Summer heat may exceed the upper insulation limit, and winter cold may freeze the product

blocks.zh: 運輸模式差異：空運（機艙溫度波動大）、海運（長時間）、陸運（停靠點暴露）
blocks.en: Differences between transport modes: Air (large cabin temperature swings), sea (long duration) and road (exposure at stops)

blocks.zh: 實際路線驗證：不是在實驗室模擬就夠，要在真實供應鏈路線上實測
blocks.en: Validation on actual routes: Laboratory simulation is not enough; testing must be done on real supply chain routes

blocks.zh: 第 16-20 題聚焦乾冰管理，這是常被忽略但極重要的環節。乾冰會持續昇華，存放時間過長就失去保冷效果。
blocks.en: Questions 16-20 focus on dry ice management, an often overlooked but very important area. Dry ice sublimes continuously, so if it is stored too long it loses its cooling effect.

blocks.zh: RCA 與 CAPA 的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of RCA and CAPA

blocks.zh: Root Cause Analysis, RCA（根本原因分析）和 Corrective and Preventive Action, CAPA（矯正與預防措施）是品質管理的核心工具。當保溫系統失敗時，不能只是「換一個新箱子」，必須找出根本原因並採取系統性的預防措施。
blocks.en: Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) are core quality management tools. When an insulated shipping system fails, it is not enough to just "swap in a new box"; the root cause must be found and systematic preventive measures taken.

blocks.zh: 如果一個 ISS 在實驗室通過驗證，但在實際運輸中失敗，可能的原因是什麼？
blocks.en: If an ISS passes validation in the laboratory but fails in actual transport, what are the possible reasons?

blocks.zh: 為什麼乾冰的「conditioning time（調節時間）」很重要？
blocks.en: Why is dry ice "conditioning time" important?

blocks.zh: 運輸途中發生溫度偏移時，應急計畫 (contingency plan) 應包含哪些要素？
blocks.en: When a temperature excursion occurs in transit, what elements should the contingency plan include?

blocks.zh: L. Carrier Transportation Temperature Controls (承運商運輸溫控)
blocks.en: L. Carrier Transportation Temperature Controls

blocks.zh: 核心概念：承運商管理的三大支柱
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Pillars of Carrier Management

blocks.zh: 本區是整份查檢表中題數最多的類別（31題），反映承運商管理的複雜性。可歸納為三大支柱：
blocks.en: This is the category with the most questions in the whole checklist (31), which reflects the complexity of carrier management. It can be summarized in three pillars:

blocks.zh: 溫度控制 (Temperature Control)：車輛預冷、連續監控、校正、警報設定（第7、10-18題）
blocks.en: Temperature Control: Vehicle pre-cooling, continuous monitoring, calibration and alarm settings (Questions 7 and 10-18)

blocks.zh: 安全保障 (Security)：封條管理、GPS追蹤、駕駛員身分驗證、防盜程序（第19-22、28-30題）
blocks.en: Security: Seal management, GPS tracking, driver identity verification and anti-theft procedures (Questions 19-22 and 28-30)

blocks.zh: 文件與合約 (Documentation & Agreements)：服務協議、路線認證、裝載模式、程序文件（第1-6、25-26、31題）
blocks.en: Documentation & Agreements: Service agreements, route qualification, loading patterns and procedural documents (Questions 1-6, 25-26 and 31)

blocks.zh: 承運商管理就像委託一家搬家公司搬運價值連城的古董。你不會只看價格就決定——你會檢查：搬家車有沒有避震裝置（溫控設備）？司機有沒有執照和犯罪紀錄查核（駕駛員驗證）？車門有沒有上鎖並貼封條（封條管理）？你能不能即時追蹤車子在哪裡（GPS）？如果路上出了問題怎麼處理（應急計畫）？
blocks.en: Managing a carrier is like hiring a moving company to move a priceless antique. You would not decide on price alone; you would check whether the truck has shock absorbers (temperature control equipment), whether the driver has a license and a background check (driver verification), whether the doors are locked and sealed (seal management), whether you can track the truck in real time (GPS), and how problems on the road are handled (contingency plan).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Temperature Mapping 與 Preconditioning
blocks.en: Key Point: Temperature Mapping and Preconditioning

blocks.zh: Temperature Mapping（溫度分佈驗證）：在冷藏車內不同位置放置感測器，確認整車各角落都能維持在規定溫度範圍。這與倉庫溫度分佈驗證的概念相同。
blocks.en: Temperature Mapping: Sensors are placed at different positions in the refrigerated vehicle to confirm that every corner of the load space stays within the specified temperature range. The concept is the same as warehouse temperature mapping.

blocks.zh: Preconditioning（預冷/預熱）：裝貨前必須先將車廂調至目標溫度。如果把 2-8°C 的藥品裝進一輛 25°C 的車廂，即使製冷設備馬上啟動，車廂降溫也需要時間，這段時間產品可能已經超溫。
blocks.en: Preconditioning: The cargo space must be brought to the target temperature before loading. If 2-8°C products are loaded into a 25°C cargo space, even if the refrigeration unit starts immediately, the space takes time to cool, and during that time the product may already be out of temperature.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：封條與監管鏈
blocks.en: Key Point: Seals and Chain of Custody

blocks.zh: 第 19-20 題關於封條 (Seals)，這是維護監管鏈 (Chain of Custody)的物理證據。封條號碼必須：
blocks.en: Questions 19-20 concern seals, which are the physical evidence that maintains the Chain of Custody. The seal number must be:

blocks.zh: 裝貨時記錄在出貨文件上
blocks.en: Recorded on the shipping documents at loading

blocks.zh: 到貨時由收貨方核對確認完整無損
blocks.en: Checked by the receiver on arrival to confirm the seal is intact

blocks.zh: 封條破損或號碼不符代表可能有未授權的開啟，必須啟動調查
blocks.en: A broken seal or mismatched number suggests possible unauthorized opening, and an investigation must be started

blocks.zh: 為什麼第 27 題要求車輛在裝貨前必須有足夠燃油？這與藥品品質有什麼關係？
blocks.en: Why does Question 27 require the vehicle to have sufficient fuel before loading? How does this relate to product quality?

blocks.zh: 團隊駕駛 (team drivers) 與單人駕駛 (solo drivers) 各有什麼優缺點？
blocks.en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of team drivers versus solo drivers?

blocks.zh: 如果承運商使用分包商 (subcontractors)，品質責任如何界定？
blocks.en: If the carrier uses subcontractors, how is quality responsibility defined?

blocks.zh: M. Customer Returns (客戶退貨)
blocks.en: M. Customer Returns

blocks.zh: 核心概念：退貨的品質風險
blocks.en: Core Concept: Quality Risks of Returns

blocks.zh: Customer Returns（客戶退貨）是 GDP 中風險最高的環節之一。一旦產品離開了你的控制範圍（離開倉庫到了客戶手中），你就無法確定產品在這段期間經歷了什麼：
blocks.en: Customer Returns are among the highest-risk areas in GDP. Once a product has left your control (left the warehouse and reached the customer), you cannot be sure what it went through in the meantime:

blocks.zh: 是否曾暴露在不當溫度下？
blocks.en: Was it exposed to inappropriate temperatures?

blocks.zh: 是否曾被開封或篡改？
blocks.en: Was it opened or tampered with?

blocks.zh: 是否曾與其他物質接觸導致交叉污染？
blocks.en: Did it come into contact with other substances, causing cross-contamination?

blocks.zh: 監管鏈 (Chain of Custody) 是否完整？
blocks.en: Is the Chain of Custody intact?

blocks.zh: 因此，退貨產品不能自動回到正常庫存，必須經過 QA 嚴格評估。
blocks.en: Therefore, returned products must not automatically go back into normal stock and must undergo strict QA evaluation.

blocks.zh: 退貨品管就像餐廳對待退回的菜餚。如果客人說「這道菜我沒吃」要退回，餐廳不會把它端給下一位客人——因為你不知道它在客人桌上發生了什麼。同樣地，退回的藥品即使外觀完好，也必須經過完整評估才能決定是否能重新上架。
blocks.en: Quality control of returns is like a restaurant handling a dish sent back. If a guest says "I haven't touched this dish" and returns it, the restaurant will not serve it to the next guest, because it does not know what happened to it at the guest's table. Likewise, even if a returned medicine looks intact, it must go through a full evaluation before it can be put back on the shelf.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：物理隔離的必要性
blocks.en: Key Point: The Need for Physical Segregation

blocks.zh: 第 4 題強調退貨品必須物理隔離 (Physical Segregation)。這不是在系統中標記「待檢」就夠了——必須實際放在不同的區域，有明確標示，防止與合格庫存混淆。這是防止未經評估的產品流入市場的最基本控制措施。
blocks.en: Question 4 stresses that returned goods must be physically segregated. Marking them "pending inspection" in the system is not enough; they must actually be placed in a separate, clearly labeled area to prevent mix-up with approved stock. This is the most basic control to keep unevaluated product from reaching the market.

blocks.zh: 在什麼條件下，退回的溫度敏感藥品可以重新入庫銷售？
blocks.en: Under what conditions can a returned temperature-sensitive medicine be restocked and sold again?

blocks.zh: 如果無法驗證退回產品的監管鏈，應該如何處理？
blocks.en: How should returned product be handled if its chain of custody cannot be verified?

blocks.zh: N. Complaints (投訴)
blocks.en: N. Complaints

blocks.zh: 核心概念：投訴管理系統
blocks.en: Core Concept: Complaint Management System

blocks.zh: 投訴管理是 GDP 品質系統的重要回饋機制。注意此處將投訴分為三類：
blocks.en: Complaint management is an important feedback mechanism in the GDP quality system. Note that complaints are divided here into three types:

blocks.zh: 配銷投訴 (Distribution Complaints)：如出貨延遲、數量錯誤、包裝損壞
blocks.en: Distribution Complaints: Such as late shipment, wrong quantity or damaged packaging

blocks.zh: 產品/包裝投訴 (Product/Packaging Complaints)：如產品外觀異常、標籤錯誤
blocks.en: Product/Packaging Complaints: Such as abnormal product appearance or labeling errors

blocks.zh: 溫度偏移投訴 (Temperature Excursion Complaints)：如收貨時溫度超出範圍
blocks.en: Temperature Excursion Complaints: Such as a temperature out of range at receipt

blocks.zh: 不同類型的投訴需要不同的調查路徑和負責單位。
blocks.en: Different types of complaints need different investigation paths and responsible departments.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：趨勢分析與升級機制
blocks.en: Key Point: Trending and Escalation

blocks.zh: 第 3-4 題強調的不只是「處理個別投訴」，更重要的是趨勢分析 (Trending)。單一投訴可能是偶發事件，但如果同類投訴反覆出現，就代表系統性問題。升級機制 (Escalation Process) 確保重大問題能即時引起管理層注意並調動資源解決。
blocks.en: Questions 3-4 emphasize more than "handling individual complaints"; the key is Trending. A single complaint may be an isolated event, but if the same type of complaint keeps recurring, it points to a systemic problem. The Escalation Process ensures that major issues quickly reach management attention and that resources are mobilized to resolve them.

blocks.zh: 為什麼溫度偏移投訴需要獨立的處理程序？
blocks.en: Why do temperature excursion complaints need a separate handling procedure?

blocks.zh: CAPA 的「驗證有效性 (verified effective)」具體指什麼？
blocks.en: What exactly does "verified effective" mean for a CAPA?

blocks.zh: O. Counterfeit & Tampering (偽藥與篡改)
blocks.en: O. Counterfeit & Tampering

blocks.zh: 核心概念：偽藥防範
blocks.en: Core Concept: Counterfeit Prevention

blocks.zh: Counterfeit Pharmaceutical Products（偽藥）是全球公共衛生的嚴重威脅。WHO 估計，在某些地區偽藥比例可高達 30%。配銷體系是偽藥滲入合法供應鏈的主要途徑之一。
blocks.en: Counterfeit Pharmaceutical Products are a serious threat to global public health. The WHO estimates that in some regions the proportion of counterfeit medicines can be as high as 30%. The distribution system is one of the main routes by which counterfeits enter the legitimate supply chain.

blocks.zh: 本節要求配銷商必須具備：
blocks.en: This section requires the distributor to have:

blocks.zh: 辨識程序：如何識別疑似偽藥或篡改產品
blocks.en: Identification procedures: How to recognize suspected counterfeit or tampered products

blocks.zh: 隔離措施：疑似品必須立即隔離，防止進入市場
blocks.en: Segregation measures: Suspect products must be segregated immediately to keep them from reaching the market

blocks.zh: 通報機制：必須通知 MAH（上市許可持有者）和主管機關
blocks.en: Notification mechanism: The MAH (marketing authorization holder) and the competent authority must be notified

blocks.zh: 處置程序：確認為偽藥的產品必須銷毀或退回
blocks.en: Disposition procedures: Products confirmed as counterfeit must be destroyed or returned

blocks.zh: 重點提示：異常訂單偵測
blocks.en: Key Point: Detecting Unusual Orders

blocks.zh: 第 5 題關於可疑訂單 (Suspicious Orders)的偵測是近年來的重點監管要求。異常模式可能包括：
blocks.en: Question 5 concerns detection of Suspicious Orders, a regulatory focus in recent years. Unusual patterns may include:

blocks.zh: 某客戶突然大量訂購特定產品
blocks.en: A customer suddenly ordering large quantities of a specific product

blocks.zh: 訂購數量與客戶營業規模不符
blocks.en: Order quantities inconsistent with the size of the customer's business

blocks.zh: 管制藥品的異常訂購模式
blocks.en: Unusual ordering patterns for controlled substances

blocks.zh: 這些都可能是藥品轉移 (Diversion) 或非法交易的信號。
blocks.en: These may all be signs of drug Diversion or illegal trade.

blocks.zh: 配銷商如何在日常作業中辨識可能的偽藥？
blocks.en: How can a distributor recognize possible counterfeits in daily operations?

blocks.zh: 序列化 (Serialization) 技術如何幫助防範偽藥？
blocks.en: How can serialization technology help prevent counterfeits?

blocks.zh: P. Material/Product Destruction (物料/產品銷毀)
blocks.en: P. Material/Product Destruction

blocks.zh: 核心概念：銷毀管理
blocks.en: Core Concept: Destruction Management

blocks.zh: 藥品銷毀不是簡單的「丟掉」，而是一個需要嚴格管控的流程。未妥善銷毀的藥品可能：
blocks.en: Destroying medicines is not simply "throwing them away"; it is a process that needs strict control. Medicines that are not properly destroyed may:

blocks.zh: 被撿拾後重新流入市場（尤其是高價值藥品）
blocks.en: Be picked up and re-enter the market (especially high-value medicines)

blocks.zh: 造成環境污染（如化學藥品、生物製劑）
blocks.en: Cause environmental pollution (such as chemical drugs and biologicals)

blocks.zh: 違反管制藥品法規（如麻醉藥品必須有見證銷毀）
blocks.en: Violate controlled substance regulations (for example, narcotics must be destroyed under witness)

blocks.zh: 第 2a-2d 題特別針對委外銷毀的管理，要求與銷毀供應商之間有完整的稽核、紀錄與監管鏈。
blocks.en: Questions 2a-2d specifically address the management of outsourced destruction, requiring complete audits, records and chain of custody with the destruction vendor.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：不要囤積待銷毀品
blocks.en: Key Point: Do Not Stockpile Material Awaiting Destruction

blocks.zh: 第 3 題看似簡單但非常重要。待銷毀物料如果長期堆放：
blocks.en: Question 3 looks simple but is very important. If material awaiting destruction is left to pile up for a long time:

blocks.zh: 占用倉庫空間，影響正常作業
blocks.en: It takes up warehouse space and interferes with normal operations

blocks.zh: 增加混淆風險——待銷毀品可能被誤判為正常庫存
blocks.en: It increases the risk of mix-up, as material awaiting destruction may be mistaken for normal stock

blocks.zh: 管制藥品的囤積更是嚴重的法規違規
blocks.en: Stockpiling controlled substances is a serious regulatory violation

blocks.zh: 應建立定期清除機制，避免「等一等再處理」的心態。
blocks.en: A regular clearance mechanism should be established to avoid a "deal with it later" mindset.

blocks.zh: 為什麼委外銷毀需要定期稽核銷毀商？
blocks.en: Why does outsourced destruction require regular audits of the destruction vendor?

blocks.zh: 「監管鏈 (Chain of Custody)」在銷毀流程中具體指什麼？
blocks.en: What exactly does "Chain of Custody" mean in the destruction process?

blocks.zh: II. PRODUCT CONTROL (產品管控)
blocks.en: II. PRODUCT CONTROL

blocks.zh: Q. General (一般要求)
blocks.en: Q. General

blocks.zh: 核心概念：人員管理與產品管控
blocks.en: Core Concept: Personnel Management and Product Control

blocks.zh: 從 Q 區開始進入查檢表的第二大部分：Product Control（產品管控），焦點從設施與系統轉向人員。這反映了一個重要觀念：再好的設施和系統，都需要合格的人來操作。
blocks.en: From Section Q onward the checklist enters its second major part: Product Control, and the focus shifts from facilities and systems to people. This reflects an important principle: even the best facilities and systems need qualified people to operate them.

blocks.zh: 個人衛生 (Personal Hygiene)：防止人為污染產品
blocks.en: Personal Hygiene: Prevent contamination of the product by personnel

blocks.zh: 門禁管制 (Access Control)：只有授權人員才能進入特定區域
blocks.en: Access Control: Only authorized personnel may enter specific areas

blocks.zh: 背景調查與藥物檢測：確保員工的誠信度，特別是處理管制藥品的人員
blocks.en: Background Checks and Drug Testing: Ensure the integrity of employees, especially those who handle controlled substances

blocks.zh: 重點提示：GDP 與 GMP 的人員要求差異
blocks.en: Key Point: How GDP and GMP Personnel Requirements Differ

blocks.zh: GDP 的人員管理與 GMP 有相似之處但側重點不同：GMP 強調無菌操作、更衣程序等；GDP 則更關注安全性與誠信度——因為配銷人員直接接觸大量高價值、甚至管制藥品，盜竊與轉移的風險更高。
blocks.en: GDP personnel management is similar to GMP but with a different emphasis: GMP stresses aseptic operations, gowning procedures and so on, while GDP focuses more on security and integrity, because distribution staff handle large quantities of high-value, even controlled, medicines directly, and the risk of theft and diversion is higher.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 GDP 特別強調員工的藥物檢測 (Drug Testing)？
blocks.en: Why does GDP place particular emphasis on employee drug testing?

blocks.zh: 飲食區與作業區分離的目的是什麼？
blocks.en: What is the purpose of separating eating areas from work areas?

blocks.zh: R. Training (訓練)
blocks.en: R. Training

blocks.zh: 核心概念：訓練體系的四大要素
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Four Elements of a Training System

blocks.zh: GDP 訓練體系必須涵蓋四個面向：
blocks.en: A GDP training system must cover four aspects:

blocks.zh: 文件化 (Documentation)：每位員工都有訓練紀錄，且隨時可調閱（第1、4、13題）
blocks.en: Documentation: Every employee has a training record that is available at any time (Questions 1, 4 and 13)

blocks.zh: 涵蓋性 (Coverage)：包含正式員工、約聘人員、臨時工和承包商（第2、15-16題）
blocks.en: Coverage: Includes permanent employees, contract staff, temporary workers and contractors (Questions 2 and 15-16)

blocks.zh: 持續性 (Continuity)：年度覆核、文件變更後再訓練、定期 cGMP 訓練（第5-6、10題）
blocks.en: Continuity: Annual review, retraining after document changes and periodic cGMP training (Questions 5-6 and 10)

blocks.zh: 針對性 (Specificity)：依職位設計訓練課程，包括異常事件處理（第7-9、11題）
blocks.en: Specificity: Training courses designed by job role, including handling of abnormal events (Questions 7-9 and 11)

blocks.zh: 訓練體系就像駕照制度。你不能只是「學會開車」就永遠合格——你需要通過考試（初始訓練）、定期換照（年度覆核）、違規後可能需要重考（事件後再訓練）。而且不同車型需要不同駕照（不同職位的訓練課程）。約聘司機也必須持有合格駕照（承包商訓練要求）。
blocks.en: A training system is like a driver's license system. You cannot just "learn to drive" and stay qualified forever; you must pass a test (initial training), renew the license periodically (annual review), and may need to retake the test after a violation (retraining after an event). Different vehicle types need different licenses (role-specific training courses). Contract drivers must also hold valid licenses (contractor training requirements).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：訓練者的資格
blocks.en: Key Point: Qualification of Trainers

blocks.zh: 第 12 題問的是「訓練者如何被資格化」——這是常被忽略但極為重要的問題。如果訓練者本身不具備足夠的知識和教學能力，訓練的品質就無法保證。常見做法包括：
blocks.en: Question 12 asks "how trainers are qualified", an often overlooked but extremely important question. If the trainer lacks sufficient knowledge and teaching ability, the quality of the training cannot be assured. Common practices include:

blocks.zh: 講師需完成「Train the Trainer」課程
blocks.en: Trainers must complete a "Train the Trainer" course

blocks.zh: 講師需具備相關領域的工作經驗
blocks.en: Trainers must have work experience in the relevant field

blocks.zh: 講師資格須經 QA 核准
blocks.en: Trainer qualifications must be approved by QA

blocks.zh: 為什麼第 8 題特別要求員工能識別「異常事件或溫度偏移」？
blocks.en: Why does Question 8 specifically require employees to be able to recognize "abnormal events or temperature excursions"?

blocks.zh: 如果稽核員發現某位堆高機操作員沒有堆高機操作證照，這代表什麼問題？
blocks.en: If an auditor finds that a forklift operator has no forklift operating certification, what problem does this indicate?

blocks.zh: 約聘/臨時人員的訓練管理有哪些特殊挑戰？
blocks.en: What special challenges are there in managing training for contract/temporary staff?

blocks.zh: S. Safety (安全)
blocks.en: S. Safety

blocks.zh: 核心概念：倉庫安全管理
blocks.en: Core Concept: Warehouse Safety Management

blocks.zh: 安全管理看似與 GDP 品質無直接關係，但實際上密不可分：
blocks.en: Safety management may seem unrelated to GDP quality, but the two are in fact inseparable:

blocks.zh: 堆高機事故可能損壞藥品、造成產品污染或交叉混淆
blocks.en: Forklift accidents can damage medicines and cause product contamination or cross-mix-ups

blocks.zh: 危險品洩漏可能污染周圍儲存的藥品
blocks.en: Hazardous material leaks can contaminate medicines stored nearby

blocks.zh: 消防設施不足可能導致火災中大量藥品損失
blocks.en: Inadequate fire protection can lead to the loss of large quantities of medicines in a fire

blocks.zh: 高事故率反映管理鬆散，也暗示品質管理可能同樣不嚴謹
blocks.en: A high accident rate reflects lax management and suggests that quality management may be equally lax

blocks.zh: 一個安全管理良好的倉庫，通常也是 GDP 合規表現良好的倉庫。
blocks.en: A warehouse with good safety management is usually also a warehouse with good GDP compliance.

blocks.zh: 安全與品質的關係，就像一家餐廳的廚房衛生與消防安全。如果廚房連滅火器都沒有、廚師沒有持有衛生證照，你會信任他們做出安全的食物嗎？同樣地，如果一個倉庫的安全管理混亂，稽核員有理由懷疑其品質管理也不到位。
blocks.en: The relationship between safety and quality is like kitchen hygiene and fire safety in a restaurant. If the kitchen does not even have a fire extinguisher and the cooks hold no hygiene certificates, would you trust them to make safe food? Likewise, if safety management in a warehouse is chaotic, the auditor has reason to suspect that its quality management is also inadequate.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：LOTO 與 OSHA 指標
blocks.en: Key Point: LOTO and OSHA Metrics

blocks.zh: Lock Out/Tag Out, LOTO（上鎖/掛牌）：維修設備時，將設備能源切斷並上鎖，防止他人誤啟動。這是倉庫中輸送帶、自動化設備維護的標準安全程序。
blocks.en: Lock Out/Tag Out (LOTO): When equipment is serviced, its energy sources are cut off and locked so that no one can start it by mistake. This is the standard safety procedure for maintaining conveyors and automated equipment in a warehouse.

blocks.zh: OSHA Recordable Rate 與 LWD Rate：這是美國職業安全與衛生管理局 (OSHA) 的標準安全指標。高數值代表該場所的安全表現不佳，可能影響稽核評分。
blocks.en: OSHA Recordable Rate and LWD Rate: These are standard safety metrics of the US Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA). High values indicate poor safety performance at the site and may affect the audit score.

blocks.zh: 為什麼安全激勵措施 (Safety Incentives) 對 GDP 合規有間接幫助？
blocks.en: Why do safety incentives indirectly help GDP compliance?

blocks.zh: 堆高機駕駛員發生事故後為什麼需要重新認證？
blocks.en: Why must forklift drivers be recertified after an accident?

blocks.zh: 承包商的安全訓練為什麼是稽核重點？
blocks.en: Why is contractor safety training an audit focus?

blocks.zh: Observations and Recommendations / Notes (觀察、建議與備註)
blocks.en: Observations and Recommendations / Notes

blocks.zh: 核心概念：稽核結論與後續行動
blocks.en: Core Concept: Audit Conclusions and Follow-up Actions

blocks.zh: 查檢表的最後三個部分構成了稽核的正式結論：
blocks.en: The last three sections of the checklist make up the formal conclusion of the audit:

blocks.zh: Observations & Recommendations（觀察與建議）：稽核員在稽核過程中記錄的具體發現。這些可能是缺失 (Deficiency)、觀察 (Observation)、或改善建議 (Recommendation)
blocks.en: Observations & Recommendations: The specific findings the auditor records during the audit. These may be a Deficiency, an Observation or a Recommendation

blocks.zh: Notes（備註）：補充性的記錄，可能包含待追蹤的項目、需要額外文件佐證的事項等
blocks.en: Notes: Supplementary records, which may include items to follow up, matters needing additional supporting documents, and so on

blocks.zh: Site Evaluation（場所評估）：最終的核准/不核准決定，以及報告完成的時間承諾（稽核日後 30 天內）
blocks.en: Site Evaluation: The final approval/non-approval decision, and the commitment on report completion time (within 30 days after the audit)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：雙重簽名的意義
blocks.en: Key Point: The Meaning of the Dual Signatures

blocks.zh: Site Evaluation 區域要求兩個簽名，通常代表：
blocks.en: The Site Evaluation section requires two signatures, which usually represent:

blocks.zh: 主稽核員 (Lead Auditor) 的簽名
blocks.en: The signature of the Lead Auditor

blocks.zh: 品質管理主管或委託方代表的簽名
blocks.en: The signature of the head of quality management or the sponsor's representative

blocks.zh: 這確保了稽核結論經過獨立複核，不是單一稽核員的主觀判斷。30 天內完成報告的要求也確保了時效性——拖延太久可能導致觀察到的問題惡化而未被處理。
blocks.en: This ensures that the audit conclusion has been independently reviewed and is not the subjective judgment of a single auditor. The requirement to complete the report within 30 days also ensures timeliness, since a long delay may allow observed problems to worsen without being addressed.

blocks.zh: Observation 與 Deficiency 有什麼區別？對被稽核方的影響有何不同？
blocks.en: What is the difference between an Observation and a Deficiency? How do they differ in impact on the audited party?

blocks.zh: 為什麼稽核報告有 30 天的完成期限？
blocks.en: Why does the audit report have a 30-day completion deadline?

blocks.zh: Appendix 4.1 查檢表完整回顧 — Section Summary
blocks.en: Appendix 4.1 Full Checklist Review - Section Summary

blocks.zh: 系統 (J)：WMS 是 GDP 的數位骨幹，必須支援批號追蹤、FEFO、QA Hold、溫控區域辨識、條碼/RF 技術及災難復原
blocks.en: Systems (J): The WMS is the digital backbone of GDP and must support lot tracking, FEFO, QA Hold, temperature-zone recognition, barcode/RF technology and disaster recovery

blocks.zh: 保溫運輸 (K)：ISS 的選擇與驗證必須涵蓋季節極端、不同運輸模式、實際路線測試；乾冰管理與冷媒調節時間是常見缺失點
blocks.en: Insulated Shipping (K): ISS selection and validation must cover seasonal extremes, different transport modes and testing on actual routes; dry ice management and coolant conditioning time are common weak points

blocks.zh: 承運商管理 (L)：最大的查檢類別（31題），涵蓋溫控、安全、文件三大支柱；封條管理與 GPS 追蹤是維護監管鏈的關鍵
blocks.en: Carrier Management (L): The largest checklist category (31 questions), covering the three pillars of temperature control, security and documentation; seal management and GPS tracking are key to maintaining chain of custody

blocks.zh: 客戶退貨 (M)：退貨品必須物理隔離並經 QA 完整評估，監管鏈的完整性決定產品能否重新入庫
blocks.en: Customer Returns (M): Returned goods must be physically segregated and fully evaluated by QA, and the integrity of the chain of custody determines whether the product can be restocked

blocks.zh: 投訴處理 (N)：分類處理（配銷、產品、溫度偏移），重點在趨勢分析與 CAPA 有效性驗證
blocks.en: Complaint Handling (N): Complaints are handled by category (distribution, product, temperature excursion), with the emphasis on trending and verification of CAPA effectiveness

blocks.zh: 偽藥防範 (O)：必須有辨識、隔離、通報、處置的完整流程；異常訂單偵測是關鍵預防措施
blocks.en: Counterfeit Prevention (O): A complete process of identification, segregation, notification and disposition is required; detection of unusual orders is a key preventive measure

blocks.zh: 銷毀管理 (P)：委外銷毀需要稽核、紀錄與監管鏈；避免囤積待銷毀物料
blocks.en: Destruction Management (P): Outsourced destruction needs audits, records and chain of custody; avoid stockpiling material awaiting destruction

blocks.zh: 人員管理 (Q)：從「設施系統」轉向「人員」，強調衛生、門禁、背景調查與藥物檢測
blocks.en: Personnel Management (Q): The focus shifts from "facilities and systems" to "people", stressing hygiene, access control, background checks and drug testing

blocks.zh: 訓練 (R)：文件化、涵蓋性、持續性、針對性四大要素缺一不可；訓練者本身的資格化也是稽核重點
blocks.en: Training (R): The four elements of documentation, coverage, continuity and specificity are all indispensable; qualification of the trainers themselves is also an audit focus

blocks.zh: 安全 (S)：安全管理反映整體管理水準；LOTO、OSHA 指標、堆高機管理是關鍵稽核項目
blocks.en: Safety (S): Safety management reflects the overall level of management; LOTO, OSHA metrics and forklift management are key audit items

blocks.zh: 稽核結論：觀察與建議需文件化記錄，場所評估需雙重簽名，報告須在 30 天內完成
blocks.en: Audit Conclusion: Observations and recommendations must be documented, the site evaluation needs dual signatures, and the report must be completed within 30 days

blocks.zh: 整份查檢表的核心精神：GDP 不是單一面向的合規要求，而是涵蓋設施、設備、系統、運輸、人員、安全的全面性品質體系。每個環節都相互關聯——設施再好，沒有合格的人操作就無法確保品質；人員再優秀，沒有可靠的系統支持就容易出錯。稽核的價值在於系統性地檢視每個環節，找出薄弱點並推動持續改善。
blocks.en: Core Spirit of the Whole Checklist: GDP is not a single-dimension compliance requirement but a comprehensive quality system covering facilities, equipment, systems, transportation, personnel and safety. Every element is interconnected: however good the facility, quality cannot be assured without qualified people to operate it; however good the people, they are prone to error without a reliable system behind them. The value of an audit lies in systematically examining every element, finding the weak points and driving continual improvement.
